title: @bakers-build/addon-forge-github options
description: The forge entry's with.backend.with: a GitHub App, or the conductor's gh login with auth 'gh'.

repository.description: `owner/repo`; the only repository the token reaches.

auth.description: Use the conductor's own gh login instead of a GitHub App.

app_id.description: The GitHub App's ID; required unless `auth` is set.

installation_id.description: The App's installation on the repository; required unless `auth` is set.

private_key.description: The App private key (PEM); machine config only.

private_key_env.description: Names the conductor environment variable that holds the credential.
